evidence: 'Patient stories' section renders 6 verbatim Google reviews with 5-star icons and '6 verified patient reviews, all five-star'; TrustPillars embeds Pankaj Makhijani Google quote; footer 'Patient Stories' links to Google review results.

compliant_alternative: Delete the Reviews section and the TrustPillars quote; remove content/reviews.ts; relabel footer link 'Find us on Google'. Optionally convert one documented-consent case into an anonymised clinical case (age band, problem, findings, procedure, recovery, risks, outcomes vary) - otherwise drop.
seo_note: Trust signal survives via verified credentials (GMC numbers, fellowships, publications).
client_input: Want one anonymised clinical case drafted (needs documented consent) or none?

evidence: '500+ Corneal transplants by Dr. Meeta Mungale' stat chip; bio 'performed more than 500 corneal transplants'; clinicalWork 'More than 500 corneal transplants'.
why_breach: Publishing surgery counts is a prohibited promotional metric, verified or not.

seo_note: LVPEI fellowship + publications carry the same E-E-A-T hook.

evidence: 'This procedure is very safe and can be repeated. Success rate of this procedure is 90%.' (SLT); 'It is a very safe and effective procedure to treat angle-closure glaucoma.' (Nd:YAG PI)
why_breach: A stated success percentage and blanket safety claims are prohibited outcome/guarantee statements.
compliant_alternative: 'SLT lowers eye pressure for many patients and can be repeated; its effect can lessen over time and drops may still be needed.' / 'Nd:YAG iridotomy creates a small opening in the iris so fluid can drain; it is a short clinic procedure - your doctor will explain its risks and benefits.'
seo_note: Procedure keywords retained; balanced copy matches the draft guides already ranking.

evidence: 'gold standard for eye examination'; 'most ideal way... gives accurate readings always'; 'excellent visual acuity'; 'removes cataract with high efficiency in a matter of minutes'; 'one of the largest eye operation theatres in Vadodara city... No compromise in ensuring sterility and safety!'
why_breach: Unverifiable superlatives, accuracy guarantees and outcome-speed claims on equipment/facilities.
compliant_alternative: Factual rewrites: 'An imaging slit lamp used for detailed eye examination.' / 'Goldmann applanation tonometry - the standard clinical method for measuring eye pressure.' / 'Rose K lenses improve visual acuity in keratoconus; fit and result vary by eye.' / 'Phacoemulsification is a short day-care procedure.' / 'A dedicated eye OT with two tables, two LED microscopes, general-anaesthesia capability and class-B/ETO sterilisation.'
seo_note: Model names and specs preserve equipment keywords; superlatives add no ranking value.

evidence: Promo passages inside articles: 'state-of-the-art cataract surgery... our commitment'; 'Mungale Eye Hospital is your premier choice'; 'Dr. Meeta Mungale is renowned throughout Vadodara'; 'the staff guarantees complete transparency and affordability - no hidden costs'; 'we offer complete vision care'.
why_breach: Educational articles lose protection when they turn into promotion; superlatives and guarantees inside posts breach 8.1.
compliant_alternative: Delete or neutralise each promo sentence; keep single factual self-references only where they help ('the cornea team can assess...' linked to the treatment page).
seo_note: Trimming fluff improves answer-quality signals; neutral titles already in place - no redirects.

evidence: Site-wide generated artwork (hero iris, CTA band, specialty still-lifes, journey/blog art); AI-generated blog covers (cataract cover has before/after eye inset; glaucoma cover shows a third-party brand logo); editorial policy has no AI disclosure; alts say 'Illustration:' only.
why_breach: AI assistance must be disclosed in the editorial policy and AI images labelled; the cataract cover's before/after inset is a misleading AI image implying a surgical result.
compliant_alternative: Add an 'AI use' paragraph to /editorial-policy/; change labels to 'AI-generated illustration:'; replace the cataract cover before/after inset; never AI-generate patients/doctors.
seo_note: Honest labelling adds a transparency signal engines reward.
client_input: Confirm which assets are AI-generated for accurate wording.

evidence: Doctor avatars beside 'Book a consultation' in the hero; doctor portrait as OG share image; large portraits beside 'Book with this doctor' cards.

compliant_alternative: Move all unapproved patient files out of public/ (e.g. into archive/assets/) until the consent/approval flags are legitimately flipped - makes the existing gates real.
seo_note: Prevents before/after images surfacing in image search under the hospital name.
